 School Holiday Today (November 19, 2026): Will Schools Remain Closed? Check State-Wise List
 By Sahil Behl Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 06:10 IST School Holiday November 19, 2026: Schools in six Odisha districts will remain closed due to Cyclone Akvan. Goa and Gujarat will also continue their Diwali vacations. Check the state-wise school holiday status for Delhi, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh and other states.
 School Holiday Today (November 19, 2026): Will Schools Remain Closed? Check State-Wise List Register for Result Updates Schools across India will follow different schedules on Thursday, November 19, 2026, due to scheduled festive vacations and local administrative orders. While schools in most states are expected to conduct regular classes, closures have been announced in several districts of Odisha in view of Cyclone Akvan. Schools in Goa and Gujarat will also remain closed as their Diwali vacations are still underway. 
 The Odisha government has ordered the closure of schools in six districts from November 19 to 21 as a precautionary measure.

 Odisha Schools Closed in Six Districts 
 The Odisha government has ordered all government, aided and private schools, along with Anganwadi centres, to remain closed from November 19 to 21 in six districts. The decision has been taken as a precautionary measure in view of Cyclone Akvan. 
 The affected districts are Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara and Kandhamal. District Collectors have also been authorised to assess the situation and decide whether the closure needs to be extended beyond November 21. 
 Collectors in other districts have been asked to monitor local conditions and take appropriate decisions regarding school closures. 
 Goa and Gujarat Schools to Remain Closed 
 Schools in Goa will continue their scheduled Diwali vacation until November 21. As November 22 is a Sunday, schools are expected to reopen on November 23. 
 Similarly, schools in Gujarat will remain closed as part of the scheduled Diwali break, which continues until November 25. Regular academic activities are expected to resume on November 26. 
 Will Schools Remain Closed in Delhi-NCR, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh? 
 No blanket school holiday has been announced for Delhi-NCR, Bihar or Uttar Pradesh on November 19. Schools in these regions are expected to conduct regular classes as per their respective schedules. 
 Bihar schools have reopened after the extended Diwali and Chhath Puja break, while no fresh statewide closure order has been announced for Uttar Pradesh. 
 Students and parents should check their respective school notices for any district-specific or institution-level changes.
